title: Add core handoff validation tests
description: Add focused unit tests for the handoff domain contract introduced by the foundation task: valid global and task-scoped records, canonical lowercase UUID requirements, optional author rules, required trimmed message, required UTC timestamp, and TaskView JSON omitempty behavior. Confirm handoffs are view-only and do not appear in persisted Task JSON. Keep tests table-driven and avoid duplicating flat-file behavior coverage.
